units.subject: Classical artificial intelligence

units.outcome: Implement search and probabilistic inference and assess failure cases.

units.subject: Machine learning and optimization

units.subject: Parallel computing and performance

units.subject: Advanced algorithms and complexity

units.subject: Advanced systems and architecture

units.subject: Research reproduction I

units.subject: Advanced engineering design and project planning
units.scope: Stakeholders; trade studies; reliability budgets; security design; engineering economics; test strategy
units.outcome: Submit a reviewed capstone specification, alternatives analysis and feasibility prototype.

units.subject: Primary specialization II

units.subject: Advanced software engineering and operations

units.outcome: Run a realistic deployment, backup restoration and incident exercise.

units.subject: Research reproduction II

units.outcome: Defend a replication report that separates reproduction failure from a refuted claim.

units.subject: Capstone prototype and external design review

units.subject: Graduate mathematics gap repair

units.subject: Graduate specialization seminar

units.subject: Independent engineering system I

units.outcome: Deliver a usable alpha meeting baseline functional and fault-tolerance requirements.

units.subject: Bounded research investigation I

units.subject: Professional review and independent practice

units.outcome: Respond to substantive review and maintain a change and decision log.

units.subject: Independent engineering system II
